channel_accounts_wecom_check.name: channel_accounts_wecom_check
channel_accounts_wecom_check.value: "channel_accounts"."kind" <> 'wecom_kf' OR (coalesce("channel_accounts"."id_prefix" IN ('wecom:', 'wecom:' || "channel_accounts"."key" || ':'), false) AND "channel_accounts"."corp_id" IS NOT NULL AND "channel_accounts"."open_kfid" IS NOT NULL AND "channel_accounts"."secrets_ct" IS NOT NULL AND "channel_accounts"."secrets_key_id" IS NOT NULL)

channel_accounts_web_check.name: channel_accounts_web_check
channel_accounts_web_check.value: "channel_accounts"."kind" <> 'web' OR ("channel_accounts"."id_prefix" IS NULL AND "channel_accounts"."corp_id" IS NULL AND "channel_accounts"."open_kfid" IS NULL AND "channel_accounts"."secrets_ct" IS NULL AND "channel_accounts"."cursor" IS NULL AND "channel_accounts"."record_only_until" IS NULL)

messages_author_human_check.name: messages_author_human_check
messages_author_human_check.value: "messages"."author" = 'human' OR ("messages"."author_user_id" IS NULL AND "messages"."author_name" IS NULL)
